description: You wake up on a beach. No boat. No phone. Just sand, sea — and one palm tree.

provenance.prompt: You wake up on a beach. No boat. No phone. Just sand, sea — and one palm tree.

description: Survival runs on the rule of threes. Three hours without shelter. Three days without water. Three weeks without food. So the order matters.

provenance.prompt: Survival runs on the rule of threes. Three hours without shelter. Three days without water. Three weeks without food. So the order matters.

description: First, stop. Breathe. Take stock — then salvage everything the tide gives you.

provenance.prompt: First, stop. Breathe. Take stock — then salvage everything the tide gives you.

description: Step one: shelter. Get out of the sun, above the high-tide line — a driftwood frame, a palm-frond roof.

provenance.prompt: Step one: shelter. Get out of the sun, above the high-tide line — a driftwood frame, a palm-frond roof.

description: Step two: water. Never drink the sea — the salt dries you out faster. Catch the rain. Crack green coconuts. Build a solar still.

provenance.prompt: Step two: water. Never drink the sea — the salt dries you out faster. Catch the rain. Crack green coconuts. Build a solar still.

description: Step three: fire. Friction, patience, dry coconut husk — and now you have clean water, cooked food, and warmth.

provenance.prompt: Step three: fire. Friction, patience, dry coconut husk — and now you have clean water, cooked food, and warmth.

description: Step four: food — the last priority. Crabs, shellfish, fish from the tide pools. Cook everything. Skip the mystery berries.

provenance.prompt: Step four: food — the last priority. Crabs, shellfish, fish from the tide pools. Cook everything. Skip the mystery berries.

description: Step five: get seen. Spell S-O-S in rocks on the sand, and keep three fires ready to light.

provenance.prompt: Step five: get seen. Spell S-O-S in rocks on the sand, and keep three fires ready to light.

description: Shelter. Water. Fire. Food. Signal. Do them in order — and you'll still be here when rescue comes.
